spec.ca_method: SG24-A3 selected 11 modules, calls 0-30, all heads, frozen
spec.cross_resolution: within the same diffusion call: first operator averaged over its heads, bilinear upsample or area downsample, second operator applied per head; then equal average over calls and second heads
spec.normalization: minmax each resulting 64x64 map; bilinear to annotation size; threshold grid unchanged
spec.crf: unchanged R2 DenseCRF applied to each cell for final-pipeline selection
spec.selection: five fixed VOC folds against FINE-P2+R2; COCO frozen transfer only
spec.pre_sg26: on FINE 64x64 per-observation mean maps at propagation depths 1-5, minmax each depth and use fixed threshold 0.425; first positive depth wins; diagnostic only
spec.storage: resumable per-image confusion counts and first-arrival counts; no image, mask or attention-map artifacts
